edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited balance key in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping written in approve.
msg.sender keys the allowance debited in transferFrom.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard in transferOwnership.
Only the owner address satisfies the onlyOwner privilege check.
acceptOwnership validates the caller against the stored newOwner.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the mapping entry for tokenOwner.
Constructor mints the supply into balances at a fixed address.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
totalSupply derives its return value from _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the constant total supply.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance and rely on its underflow check.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub twice on balances and allowances.
transfer executes the safeSub balance update, an arithmetic-sensitive operation.
approveAndCall hands control to the untrusted spender contract after updating allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner privilege check.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner privilege check.
The _newOwner parameter becomes the privileged newOwner state.
Recipient parameter to receives the credited balance in transfer.
Amount parameter tokens drives the safeSub/safeAdd balance updates.
Source parameter from keys the balance and allowance debits.
Spender parameter is the external contract invoked by receiveApproval.
data bytes are forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter controls which external contract is called.
Operand parameters a and b flow into the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used to set newOwner inside transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
The recipient parameter of transfer has no meaning outside transfer and merges into it.
The amount parameter of transfer is consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd updates inside transfer.
The from parameter is only read by transferFrom to key balance and allowance updates.
The spender parameter is only used by approveAndCall to build the external callback target.
The data parameter is only forwarded by approveAndCall into receiveApproval.
tokenAddress is only used by transferAnyERC20Token as the external call target.
SafeMath operands a and b are local to the arithmetic helper and merge into safeAdd.
